purpose: Define fixed-reference visibility separately from imperfect query-pixel/crop support while preserving every existing M4/near primary result.

goal_and_scope.user_goal: Judge target pallet presence/occlusion from an initial-keypoint-centered crop, without pose improvement.
goal_and_scope.this_contract: Conditional visibility of one fixed reference identity r, observed through a crop centered at initial q; the reference is GT-only.
goal_and_scope.crop_support_is_different: Whether any target surface occurs in a crop or at q is not the state of a particular corner/reference. A crop-support classifier can have a well-defined target with RGB/q/box while specific-reference labels can collide when identity is hidden.
goal_and_scope.unresolved: Choose and admit an operational deployment reference-association convention before any semantic training. This draft does not silently substitute reference semantics for crop support or claim they are identical.

immutable_GT_record.invariant: For one observed image/layer/target/reference, r/identity/reference_state stay fixed while only q changes.
immutable_GT_record.semantic_slot: UNKNOWN for existing R2B3 AI anchor proposals. Anchor ID is not canonical8 semantic ID.

model_inputs.reference_and_target_IDs: GT/lineage only, not supplied as model tokens in this draft
model_inputs.structural_guard: Exact three-field whitelist and array/type checks. This does not alone prove independent q/box provenance; future data admission must check initializer lineage.
model_inputs.preprocessing: q-centered RGB crop and input-only L normalization are not selected or implemented here; r never recenters/rescales the input.

identifiability.collision: One identical generated composite RGB + identical q=(5,4) + identical box can refer to ref-A uncovered(D_teacher) or ref-B fully covered(E_teacher). Both uncertainty regions are fully contained in the same crop. Current model inputs are bit-identical; labels differ.
identifiability.consequence: No deterministic RGB/q/box-only model can correctly label both hidden identities. Equal-frequency toy pairs force at least 1/2 error. This is a conditional identifiability statement, not an empirical current/source performance result.
identifiability.invariance_limit: q-jitter-invariant labels are necessary for reference identity consistency and do not establish semantic learnability.
identifiability.audit_function: identifiability_audit records identical permitted-input hashes with conflicting fixed-reference states; absence of a finite-sample collision does not prove identifiability.

separate_public_slot_alternative.proposal: A deployment-available native slot ID with independently fixed public native-to-reference correspondence could be considered in a separately versioned input contract.
separate_public_slot_alternative.not_GT_leak: A public slot identity would not reveal r/state, but it changes the model input and needs explicit protocol/source correspondence admission.
separate_public_slot_alternative.R2B3_native8_mapping: UNKNOWN; do not invent canonical8 IDs from three local AI anchor candidates.

reference_controlled_truth.original: Only an explicitly recorded conditional original D_teacher can be preserved/converted; coordinate existence, M4(r)>0, SAM positivity, or aggregate visibility does not independently certify semantic D.
reference_controlled_truth.unchanged: Every native cue cell of the entire supplied uncertainty region has alpha exactly0 => D_teacher.
reference_controlled_truth.external: Every cue cell has alpha exactly1 AND certified distinct foreground instance in front of the target => E_teacher.
reference_controlled_truth.partial: Mixed0/1 cover, any fractional alpha, missing foreground identity/front certificate, missing original D evidence, or unobservable uncertainty cells => U.
reference_controlled_truth.q_independence: Covering q alone never changes reference D; a target-visible q/nearby surface never cancels reference E.
reference_controlled_truth.self: Only independently admitted semantic-self evidence may preserve S. Mask0, same-target layers, convex-cuboid orientation, or ray fractions cannot manufacture semantic S.
reference_controlled_truth.outframe: Reference out-of-frame F is separate from q out-of-frame and semantic E/S. Invalid reference evidence is U.
reference_controlled_truth.no_O_class: Query-pixel O/physical absence is never a reference D/E/S class.

uncertainty_geometry.required: Explicit GT-only uncertainty_bbox containing r; it must include visual-feature uncertainty as well as coordinate uncertainty.
uncertainty_geometry.selection: NOT_SELECTED; no radius from current223/human-metric tradeoffs.
uncertainty_geometry.raster: Continuous half-open XYXY box. Each integer native pixel has cell[j-.5,j+.5); include all cells with positive-area overlap. Conservative cell bounds floor(lo+.5),ceil(hi+.5), half-open.
uncertainty_geometry.image_edge: Outside-image uncertainty cells remain in the denominator; they cannot be clipped away to certify full opacity or full observation.

crop_availability.FULL: Entire uncertainty region within the actually observed q-centered crop/image footprint; conditional D/E is a proposed mathematical training target.
crop_availability.PARTIAL: Some but not all uncertainty region observed => training U, underlying reference D/E unchanged.
crop_availability.MISS: No observed uncertainty-region overlap => location/evidence teacher flag and training U; never E/O or physical absence.
crop_availability.INVALID: Nonfinite q, invalid L, or invalid reference region => U with explicit reason.
crop_availability.query_outframe: Separate query_frame flag. It does not change reference state or turn it into F. An out-of-frame center can geometrically retain FULL evidence for a sufficiently large input-only crop; no such crop policy is selected here.
crop_availability.reference_vs_training_target: reference_state and availability-conditioned training_target are different fields. All outputs keep training_authorized=false because data admission remains HOLD.

native_audits.exact: Original nearest q pixel support remains a separate audit.
native_audits.radius2: Original fixed native5x5 support remains a separate audit/target; not a replacement for any primary.
counterexamples: ReferenceE with visible q and nearV
SemanticS with visible projected target surface
native_audits.no_reinterpretation: All V61-V68 M4/exact/radius2 labels, primary tables, scores, thresholds, model/runtime/code seals remain unchanged.

query_jitter.q0: Independent frozen initial proposal when available. Existing SYNTH initial q is stored N3/SubPix output, not a fresh jitter sample.
query_jitter.rule: Change only q=q0+delta; r,target/referenceID,uncertainty and controlled source state remain fixed. delta never enters model inputs.
query_jitter.future_freeze: Derive scale only from independently admitted source initializer residuals or a priori input specifications. Never current223 coordinates/metrics, source posthoc best radius, or annotation-conditioned crops.
query_jitter.siblings: All jitters, original/composite twins, same scene/session/sensor siblings and donor lineage stay grouped within one split. More jitter records do not increase independent reference-label evidence.

SYNTH.q_lineage: All source q are preserved initial estimates, not newly generated jitter.
SYNTH.native_reference_convention: camera_dynamic_0123_v4/native index lineage is present; operational semantic/physical-corner interpretation still needs review.
SYNTH.occlusion_fraction9: Conditional external9ray blockage proxy; no retained center-ray hit IDs/depth ownership. Not semantic corner gold.
SYNTH.convex_self: Conditional convex-cuboid front-facing proxy; not independent pallet semantic-self evidence.
SYNTH.kp12: Coordinate/in-frame candidates; kp12_visible has zero nonnull states. Do not transplant native8 ray labels to12points.
SYNTH.existing_M0_M4: Pixel-support facts only; neither mask0 nor maskpositive unconditionally determines a reference corner state.

R2B3_AI_ANCHOR.status: CONDITIONAL_REVIEW_CANDIDATES_ONLY; no training result or full-goal claim

source_inventory.generic_observed_pixel_anchor: Could be a separately named observed-anchor proxy after admission; random mask-positive pixels are not canonical pallet corners.
